generationMode: Built-in tool; no API key or CLI
direction: Painterly mythic strategy: ancient temples, bronze, fire, obsidian, lapis lazuli and turquoise.
provenance: Original images generated for The Duat. No external reference images or copied artwork were used. The original Duat og.png was inspected for inventory only and was not an image input.
processing: Format conversion only: RGB WebP quality 86, method 6. Original pixel dimensions and composition preserved; no crop, resize, retouch or paint-over. Source PNGs remain in Codex generated_images.
notes: These are fictional mythological illustrations, not historical source material or geographic maps.
Actual geography, interface text, god names and game rules are rendered separately in code.
Kratos depicts the ancient Greek personification of strength; the prompt excludes the modern video-game character design.

assets.alt: A bronze-lit ancient temple council room overlooking a luminous river and distant mountain temples.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide landscape hero background for The Duat historical mythology strategy game. Primary request: an ancient archaeological temple war room opening onto a vast mythic world, the feeling of a discovered civilization returning to life. Scene: monumental weathered stone columns and bronze braziers frame a terrace; a worn bronze council table and a sealed stone ruler tomb sit in the near foreground; beyond, a luminous turquoise river winds through distant mountains and ancient temple silhouettes under an immense sunlit, smoky sky. A cohesive original painterly mythic strategy game art collection: richly textured digital oil painting, strong confident brushwork, restrained gilded details, warm bronze and aged gold, deep obsidian shadows, lapis lazuli and turquoise accents, firelight, volumetric dust, rich colors, premium illustrated strategy-card finish. Evocative and beautiful, dramatic readable silhouettes, painterly rather than photorealistic or plastic 3D. No text, captions, lettering, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI, frames or card borders. Composition: panoramic widescreen 16:9, visually compelling center and right, the left third has a calm darker atmospheric region usable behind interface text; environmental depth, no close-up people. Landscape is atmospheric and impressionistic, not a geographic map. assets.alt: An archaeologist carefully brushes sand from an ancient bronze funerary mask inside a sunlit temple.
